messages:
maya: FYI customer ACME reporting streaming responses get cut off with no final chunk/finish_reason. Happens on long outputs (~40% of runs). They see a normal stream then connection closes and client never receives a final event. Repro steps below.
april: can you paste the minimal repro (curl/headers) and a raw copy of the terminal output?
maya: repro (sanitized):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"write a 1200 token summary of...","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```
Terminal output (truncated):
```
data: {"id":"r_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"The quick brown fox ..."}}]}
data: {"id":"r_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...continues"}}]}
data: {"id":"r_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"final paragraph start..."}}]}
# next expected: data: { ... "finish_reason": "stop" }
# Instead connection closed here (no [DONE], no finish_reason)
```
jordan: cc @ash (eng-runtime) — this looks like an SSE termination rather than application-level error. Opening for oncall.
sre-bot: alert: spike in client disconnects (HTTP 499 / TCP RST) for /v1/stream between 01:15-01:40 UTC. Count=312, rate up 5x over baseline.
ash: quick thought — do we see Fastly/edge sending TCP FIN/RESET? Often proxies or client middleboxes will close idle streams. Need tcpdump or proxy logs to confirm. Also check runtime send buffers for errors.
maya: customer provided nginx reverse-proxy config and a tcpdump snippet: last packet is RST from client side ~60s after last data, no HTTP [DONE]. Nginx logs show upstream finished normally but client closed socket (499).
ash: that matches proxy idle timeout. Two things to consider: 1) client side should send or accept keepalive probes, or 2) server/runtime should emit SSE comment keepalives (": keepalive\n\n") periodically to prevent idle timeouts. Also we have some logs where finish_reason was not recorded if final write failed.
april: can we ask customer to run a quick test with keepalive probes to confirm?
maya: ran quick test with manual keepalive comment every 15s (server-sim) — command used to emulate server keepalive:
```
# simulate SSE keepalive
(echo -e "data: {\"id\":\"r_test\"}\n\n"; sleep 1; for i in $(seq 1 10); do echo -e ": keepalive\n\n"; sleep 15; done; ) | nc -l 8080
```
With that in place customer observed the final chunk and finish_reason delivered reliably. Without keepalives they reproduce the truncation.
lee: thanks @maya. Runtime should definitely send comment keepalives for long-running streams. Also want to investigate why finish_reason sometimes not persisted to logs when write fails — perhaps we drop the final ack path on send errors. I'll make a ticket.
ash: short-term workaround: advise customers to configure their proxies to increase idle timeout for SSE endpoints and/or add client-side TCP keepalives. Medium-term: we'll add periodic SSE comment keepalives from the runtime and ensure final event write is retried/queued on close.
april: please prepare customer-facing note and offer credit for impacted calls.
maya: customer accepted workaround, asked for ETA on a patch. I created incident: INC-2026-4498 and linked it in case notes. Patch scheduled for next runtime minor release (approx 72h). I'll send email update and an ops runbook: include repro curl, keepalive guidance, and suggested nginx config (proxy_read_timeout 300s / proxy_send_timeout 300s).
jordan: thx team — eng-runtime (lee, ash) to own the deploy. Post any new logs here.
maya: closing loop with customer tomorrow after patch. For now workaround verified. :white_check_mark:
